**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

The second Section 12.4 (p0046) imposes a non-compete on us, not the Vendor: a 24-month post-term ban on developing, marketing, selling, *or acquiring* any product or service competing with Cobalt, in any territory. That fails the fallback on every material term — undefined scope, post-term duration over 12 months, no territory limit, and no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions (acquisitions are expressly caught). It also flatly contradicts Section 12.3 (p0044), where Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.

Redline validated (ok:true): delete Section 12.4 and rely on Section 12.3, with an offer to discuss a narrowed, product-specific, term-only restriction if Cobalt identifies a genuine need.
